answers.core: I think expanding the compiler like this is not intended to be done by add-ons
answers.workaround:
I can either make a function with two arguments, that are both optional and throw an error if none or both are is given or make two functions with a slightly altered name based on what Arguments the functions can take.

This is really a very minor complaint and I won't  be upset, if I have to wait for this feature a bit. ;)

However: given that Godot already supports constructors of built-in types to take different arguments, I imagine implementing this would not be a big deal for maintainers.

So I think it is a neat small creature comfort feature for the sake of having some more utility and consistency in gdScript. :heart:

title: Allowing multiple functions with the same name and different arguments
